input.provenance: Self-authored word and layout rendered by an external cv2.putText FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX generator then rotated clockwise with cv2.rotate; no font binary, OpenCV code, upstream image, or model asset is copied into this fixture.

limitations: The fixture covers one synthetic clockwise-rotated Latin word only; it has no multiple-region, Unicode, threshold-boundary, malformed-input, or resource-limit coverage.
The isolated source capture consumed rendered BGR bytes, not a Rust-decoded input.png; this does not select or validate decoder behavior.
The crop diagnostic records one source TextSystem crop branch only. It does not prove a Rust crop implementation or establish general OpenCV pixel equivalence.
The version fields in expected.json are immutable candidate-provenance identifiers, not an approved runtime manifest or a supported-model declaration.
Normal Rust tests only parse and hash repository files. They do not load a model, run Python, access a network, use a GPU, or inspect PaddleOCR.
